_about: Obligation Hub settings. Replace the {{TOKENS}}, then upload as AgentAssets/Config/hub-settings.json. Every hub skill reads this file first. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

_tokens.{{OUR_COMPANY}}: Legal name of the company that owns this hub, exactly as it appears in contracts (decides Party = Us).
_tokens.{{SITE_URL}}: Absolute site URL without a trailing slash, e.g. https://<tenant>.sharepoint.com/sites/<site>.
_tokens.{{LEADERSHIP_EMAILS}}: One or more email addresses. Replace the whole token string with quoted, comma-separated addresses: "a@example.com", "b@example.com". Use an empty list [] to send no leadership digest.

_keys.timeZone: Windows time zone name used for 'today' and in the workflow schedules, e.g. Pacific Standard Time, GMT Standard Time.
_keys.dueSoonDays: Days ahead that count as Due soon.
_keys.escalateAfterDaysOverdue: Days overdue before an item is escalated to its escalation owner (0 = the day after the due date).
_keys.reminderCooldownDays: Minimum days between overdue reminders for one item (at least 1).
_keys.leadershipTeamsChannel: Optional Teams team and channel names for the leadership digest; leave both empty for email only.
_keys.notifyDefault: Email, Teams or Both: the channel for people no routing rule names.
_keys.captureHoldBelowConfidence: High, Medium or Low: captured items below this confidence go to Needs review.
_keys.maxDigestItems: Most items listed in one owner digest.
